fields.summary: [Workspace] Use published libraries in application-only root

content.text: User approved an application-only root using published packages, with library development in separate checkouts. Acceptance: remove library gitlinks while preserving local repositories; retain runnable API/UI/Auth/KYC/Network/Services/SubmissionUI/Email/Logistics/Feedback services; replace source-coupled build/test/generation checks with published-artifact checks; document independent package development; verify API/UI full checks, relevant tests, registry provenance and application builds with removed directories absent. Preserve user API relocation, finance evidence and current handoff changes. No new UI behavior, database migration or deployment. AIN-179/180/181 are completed prerequisite context, not replaced; historical source extraction audit is retained as optional external-workspace tooling rather than silently described as current artifact verification.
